video_title: EXCLUSIVE: Luka Dončić on Roster Building with Rob Pelinka - Mason & Ireland at Lakers Media Day

quotes.speaker: Luka Dončić
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Dončić on his teammates adapting to his home country
quotes.excerpt: I think everybody had a great time. Obviously we know Vando, he was the one that adapted the most.

text_blocks.speaker: Mason
text_blocks.text: Who adapted the best? Who felt more at home in your home country than anyone else?

text_blocks.speaker: Luka Dončić
text_blocks.text: Me. I think everybody had a great time. Obviously we know Vando, he was the one that adapted the most.

quotes.speaker: Luka Dončić
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Dončić on the team's underrated new player signings
quotes.excerpt: There is a lot of underrated guys in our group. All the new signings are very underrated.

text_blocks.speaker: Mason
text_blocks.text: Who has impressed you that maybe isn't getting a lot of attention? For me, the answer is Adu Thiro.

text_blocks.speaker: Luka Dončić
text_blocks.text: I think there is a lot of underrated guys in our group. All the new signings are very underrated, and they are going to help us a lot.

quotes.speaker: Luka Dončić
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Dončić on his communication with Rob Pelinka during free agency
quotes.excerpt: How much contact did you have with the Lakers and Rob Pelinka as the summer moved along?

text_blocks.speaker: Ireland
text_blocks.text: How much contact did you have with the Lakers and Rob Pelinka as the summer moved along and they started signing guys?

quotes.speaker: Luka Dončić
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Dončić on his leadership style as a veteran player
quotes.excerpt: A lot of players are going to look up to me. It's my ninth year already.

text_blocks.speaker: Ireland
text_blocks.text: What does leadership mean to you and how did that figure into it?

text_blocks.speaker: Luka Dončić
text_blocks.text: A lot of players are going to look up to me. It's my ninth year already, which is crazy. I have my own way to lead. Sometimes you lead by words, sometimes you lead by example. I just think I'm my own leader.

quotes.speaker: Luka Dončić
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Dončić on prioritizing team success over individual recognition
quotes.excerpt: It's always the first the team. If the team is not great, you're not going to do anything.

text_blocks.speaker: Mason
text_blocks.text: Is it important to you that you get recognized in that upper echelon of the NBA?

text_blocks.speaker: Luka Dončić
text_blocks.text: It's obviously more about the team, but obviously you want people to talk about you. But it's always the first the team. If the team is not great, you're not going to do anything.

quotes.speaker: Luka Dončić
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Dončić on the toughest player in the league to guard
quotes.excerpt: I would say Steph. He just runs around and then you can't give him no space.

text_blocks.speaker: Ireland
text_blocks.text: Who is the toughest player in the league for you to guard?

text_blocks.speaker: Luka Dončić
text_blocks.text: I would say Steph. He just runs around and then you can't give him no space.

quotes.speaker: Luka Dončić
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Dončić on the importance of training camp for a new roster
quotes.excerpt: Going through training camp together is very important.

text_blocks.speaker: Ireland
text_blocks.text: How long is it going to take for this brand new roster to come together?

text_blocks.speaker: Luka Dončić
text_blocks.text: I don't know the answer to that question, but I feel like everybody's healthy and everybody's going to start training camp together. Going through training camp together is very important.

quotes.speaker: Luka Dončić
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Dončić on the most competitive teams in the Western Conference
quotes.excerpt: It's obviously OKC and San Antonio. I think they're the two toughest in the West.

text_blocks.speaker: Mason
text_blocks.text: Who is the team to beat in the West?

text_blocks.speaker: Luka Dončić
text_blocks.text: It's obviously OKC and San Antonio. I think they're the two toughest in the West, but I think the West is so loaded that anything can honestly surprise you. I think 10 teams can surprise you easily.
